description: A Python script for updating W3C Web Platform Tests (WPT) expectations and baselines by fetching test results from try bots, rebaselining tests, and updating expectation files accordingly.

classes.name: WPTExpectationsUpdater
classes.description: A class responsible for updating W3C test expectations and baselines by fetching test results, rebaselining tests, and modifying expectation files.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the updater with a host object and sets up a WebKitFinder.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to execute the update process: fetches test results, merges data, downloads baselines, and updates expectation files.

methods.name: get_issue_number
methods.description: Retrieves the current CL issue number via GitCL.

methods.name: get_latest_try_jobs
methods.description: Fetches the latest finished try jobs.

methods.name: get_failing_results_dict
methods.description: Retrieves a nested dictionary of failing test results for a given build.

methods.name: generate_results_dict
methods.description: Creates a dictionary of test results for a specific platform.

methods.name: merge_dicts
methods.description: Recursively merges two nested dictionaries.

methods.name: merge_same_valued_keys
methods.description: Merges dictionary keys with identical values into a tuple key.

methods.name: get_expectations
methods.description: Generates a set of test expectation strings based on test results.

methods.name: create_line_list
methods.description: Creates a list of expectation lines for the expectation file.

methods.name: specifier_part
methods.description: Generates the platform specifier part of an expectation line.

methods.name: to_list
methods.description: Converts a tuple or string to a list.

methods.name: skipped_specifiers
methods.description: Returns platform specifiers for skipped tests.

methods.name: all_try_builder_ports
methods.description: Returns a list of port objects for all try builders.

methods.name: simplify_specifiers
methods.description: Simplifies a list of specifiers into a shorter form using macros.

methods.name: write_to_test_expectations
methods.description: Writes new expectation lines into the expectation file after a marker comment.

methods.name: _test_name_from_expectation_string
methods.description: Extracts test name from an expectation string.

methods.name: download_text_baselines
methods.description: Downloads new baseline files for tests that need rebaselining.

methods.name: get_tests_to_rebaseline
methods.description: Determines which tests need to have baselines re-downloaded.

methods.name: is_js_test
methods.description: Checks if a given test path is a JavaScript testharness.js test.

methods.name: _get_try_bots
methods.description: Returns a list of all try builder names.
